register_hook: register a before, after, around, or replace hook on a target function or class by fully-qualified path
apply_hooks: apply all registered hooks to their target functions and classes via monkey-patching
wrap_function: wrap a function with a before, after, around, or replace hook using the plugin_hook decorator
reset_hooks: reset all registered hooks and patched targets for testing
replace_class: replace a class entirely with a custom subclass using HookType.REPLACE on a class target
